name: RaceDay CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, part3 ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

env:
  SOLUTION_DIR: RaceDay_Part2/Part2/RaceDay

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Restore
        run: |
          dotnet restore $SOLUTION_DIR/RaceDay.Api/RaceDay.Api.csproj
          dotnet restore $SOLUTION_DIR/RaceDay.Tests/RaceDay.Tests.csproj
          dotnet restore $SOLUTION_DIR/RaceDay.Web/RaceDay.Web.csproj

      - name: Build API
        run: dotnet build $SOLUTION_DIR/RaceDay.Api/RaceDay.Api.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Build MVC
        run: dotnet build $SOLUTION_DIR/RaceDay.Web/RaceDay.Web.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test $SOLUTION_DIR/RaceDay.Tests/RaceDay.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity normal

      - name: Build MVC Docker image
        run: docker build -t raceday-web $SOLUTION_DIR/RaceDay.Web
